row.summary_zh: Fireworks AI 的官方模型服务与推理技术博客。选择理由：推理服务提供商的一手工程案例，关注低精度、缓存与成本；数值需完整配置。

row.summary_en: A Hugging Face community for discovering and discussing papers. Why selected: Community paper discovery helps recover omissions; every conclusion must return to the author source.
row.summary_zh: Hugging Face 的论文发现社区，聚合论文与讨论。选择理由：社区论文发现入口，可补充遗漏；所有结论回到作者原文。

row.summary_en: An annual research conference focused on representation learning and deep learning. Selected to track large-model quantization, pruning, distillation and KV-cache compression and understand mechanisms and limitations through official papers and review records.
row.summary_zh: 聚焦表示学习与深度学习的年度学术会议。重点追踪大模型量化、剪枝、蒸馏和 KV Cache 压缩，通过官方论文与原文评审入口理解压缩机制及其适用边界。
row.title_en: ICLR · International Conference on Learning Representations
row.title_zh: ICLR · 国际学习表征大会

row.summary_en: An annual research conference on machine-learning theory, algorithms and applications. Selected to track compression algorithms, error analysis and efficiency evaluation and check assumptions, comparison baselines and quality–cost trade-offs against official papers.
row.summary_zh: 面向机器学习理论、算法与应用的年度学术会议。重点追踪压缩算法、误差分析与效率评测，从官方论文入口核对方法假设、对照基线和质量—成本权衡。
row.title_en: ICML · International Conference on Machine Learning
row.title_zh: ICML · 国际机器学习大会

row.summary_en: A newsletter about AI research and its implications. Why selected: A research newsletter adds cross-team trend leads; keep compression-relevant items and trace their originals.
row.summary_zh: 以人工智能研究及其影响为主题的周刊。选择理由：研究周报补充跨团队趋势线索，保留与推理压缩直接相关项并回溯原文。
row.title_zh: Import AI · 研究趋势周刊

row.summary_en: A Chinese AI technology publication covering papers, models and industry progress. Why selected: Chinese technical news adds paper and domestic-deployment leads; original papers and official code provide evidence.
row.summary_zh: 中文人工智能技术媒体，面向论文、模型和产业技术进展。选择理由：中文技术资讯补充论文与国内部署线索，原始论文和官方实现承担证据。
row.title_zh: 机器之心 · 中文技术资讯

row.summary_en: A local LLM inference project covering low-bit weights, KV precision and multiple backends. Use the official repository to inspect implementations and GGUF discussions to identify format and execution issues; performance claims still require their test configurations.
row.summary_zh: 面向本地部署的大模型推理项目，提供低比特权重、KV 精度和多后端实现。官方仓库用于核对代码，GGUF 讨论用于发现格式与执行问题；性能结论仍需结合测试配置核对。

row.summary_en: MLCommons’ inference benchmarks and public results. Consult data-center rules and results by model, quality threshold and workload, and use the main portal to follow new result releases.
row.summary_zh: MLCommons 的推理基准与公开结果入口。可按模型、质量门槛和负载设置查阅数据中心测试规则与结果，并通过总入口跟踪新的结果发布。

row.summary_en: A conference paper source at the intersection of machine learning and systems. Why selected: A central ML-systems venue for compression kernels, serving performance and hardware/software co-design.
row.summary_zh: 机器学习与计算系统交叉会议的论文入口。选择理由：机器学习系统会议总入口，与压缩算子、服务性能和软硬件协同高度相关。

row.summary_en: Ascend’s official compression toolkit produces deployable low-precision weights and caches. Follow quantization, accuracy tuning, model support and export formats to connect research with MindIE / vLLM-Ascend deployment.
row.summary_zh: 昇腾官方模型压缩工具，负责生成可部署的低精度权重与缓存。选择它来跟踪量化算法、精度调优、模型适配及导出格式，连接压缩研究与 MindIE / vLLM-Ascend 部署。

row.summary_en: NVIDIA’s official developer blog covering hardware, software stacks and implementations. Why selected: Official NVIDIA technical material tracks configuration limits of low precision, structured sparsity and inference kernels.
row.summary_zh: NVIDIA 官方开发者技术博客，介绍硬件、软件栈及实现方案。选择理由：NVIDIA官方技术材料，重点跟踪低精度、结构稀疏和推理内核的配置边界。

row.summary_en: A platform for papers, public reviews and version records. Why selected: Original submissions, revisions and reviews expose method quality and unresolved disputes.
row.summary_zh: 公开论文、评审和版本记录平台。选择理由：原始投稿、修订和审稿证据入口，用于追踪方法的质量与争议。

row.summary_en: The official CANN Transformer operator library for Attention, MoE and compute-communication fusion. Track quantized/sparse interfaces and hardware support; verify main-branch changes against released tags and CANN dependencies.
row.summary_zh: CANN 官方 Transformer 算子库，覆盖 Attention、MoE 与通算融合。选择它来追踪量化/稀疏算子的实际接口、硬件支持和主干变化；主干新特性须再核对发布标签及 CANN 配套。
row.title_zh: ops-transformer · 昇腾 Transformer 算子

row.summary_en: Paper archives for operating-systems and systems-design conferences. Why selected: Original OSDI 2026 systems work helps separate compression gains from scheduling gains.
row.summary_zh: 操作系统及系统设计会议的论文归档入口。选择理由：OSDI 2026原始系统论文与会议材料，有助于拆分压缩收益和调度收益。

row.summary_en: PyTorch’s official technical blog for framework, compilation and deployment updates. Why selected: Official PyTorch news surfaces new quantization, sparsity and compilation implementations.
row.summary_zh: PyTorch 官方技术博客，提供框架、编译与部署更新。选择理由：PyTorch官方低精度与部署动态，可发现量化、稀疏和编译的新实现。

row.summary_en: An open-source LLM runtime with implementations, engineering posts and releases. Why selected: Official SGLang releases track quantization, caching, sparse-attention and serving-support changes.
row.summary_zh: 开源大模型推理运行时，提供工程实现、博客和版本记录。选择理由：SGLang官方发布入口，追踪量化、缓存、稀疏注意力和服务支持变化。

row.summary_en: A technology-news AI section covering models, chips, startups and industry events. Why selected: Adds chip, deployment and business-cost developments; product news is not evidence of compression performance.
row.summary_zh: 科技新闻媒体的人工智能栏目，报道模型、芯片、创业公司与产业事件。选择理由：补充芯片、模型部署与商业成本动向；不把产品新闻当压缩效果证据。

row.summary_en: NVIDIA’s LLM inference library, with code, support documentation and release records. Used to compare low-precision and KV optimization implementations and check configuration requirements, hardware limits and version changes.
row.summary_zh: NVIDIA 大语言模型推理库，提供代码、支持文档和版本记录。用于对照低精度与 KV 优化的实现进展，并核对配置要求、硬件限制和版本变更。

row.summary_en: DeepLearning.AI’s AI newsletter summarizing research and industry news. Why selected: A weekly industry digest helps discover omissions; retain only efficiency and inference-compression content.
row.summary_zh: DeepLearning.AI 的人工智能资讯周刊，汇总研究和产业新闻。选择理由：周度行业摘要用于发现遗漏，仅保留模型效率与推理压缩相关内容。

row.summary_en: Together AI’s official technical blog about model serving and inference engineering. Why selected: First-party inference-engineering material adds practical limits of compression and serving deployment.
row.summary_zh: Together AI 的官方技术博客，介绍模型服务与推理工程。选择理由：一手推理工程材料，补充模型压缩和服务落地的实际限制。

row.summary_en: An open-source LLM serving project with code, documentation and release records. Used to track quantization, KV cache and sparse-compute implementations and check hardware and configuration support against its support matrix.
row.summary_zh: 开源大模型推理服务项目，提供代码、文档和版本记录。用于跟踪量化、KV 缓存与稀疏计算的实现变化，并通过支持矩阵核对具体硬件和配置。

row.summary_en: The vLLM community’s Ascend NPU plugin. Track version-specific low precision, KV caches, Attention operators and deployment constraints on Ascend, separately from upstream vLLM.
row.summary_zh: vLLM 社区维护的昇腾 NPU 适配插件。重点选择它来追踪低比特量化、KV 缓存、Attention 算子和模型部署在昇腾上的版本支持与限制；与通用 vLLM 分开核对。
